item.title: dotnet: A faster, lighter C# Dev Kit
item.description:
C# Dev Kit has been rebuilt to open solutions in about one second and use significantly less memory. The post says it explains the changes behind those improvements.

  • Source: .NET

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: SQL Performance Monitoring for Azure SQL Database
item.description:
Microsoft has opened public preview of managed SQL performance monitoring for Azure SQL Database. It provides built-in monitoring so you do not need custom data collection scripts or manual correlation across separate tools.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Support for large volume breakthrough mode
item.description:
Azure NetApp Files large volume breakthrough mode is now generally available. It adds support for volumes up to 2 PiB and throughput up to 80 GiB/s, depending on workload characteristics.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: dotnet: Performance Improvements in .NET 11
item.description:
The post says .NET 11 includes hundreds of performance improvements and invites readers to review them in detail. No specific runtime, libraries, or API changes are listed in the provided text.

  • Source: .NET

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: 2.2X IDPS performance optimization in Azure Firewall
item.description:
Azure Firewall Premium now supports up to 22 Gbps throughput with TLS inspection and IDPS in Deny mode, up from 10 Gbps. It also increases per-TCP-connection throughput with IDPS enabled in Alert or Deny mode to 600 Mbps, from 300 Mbps.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Prepared Image Specification
item.description:
Azure announces a public preview of Prepared Image Specification for AKS workloads that need faster node startup. The feature is aimed at reducing delays caused by repeated container image downloads and initialization on new nodes.

  • Source: Azure Updates
